### Props

| Name                  | Type    | Required | Default | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| --------------------- | ------- | -------- | ------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `object`              | `union` |          | `null`  | The OR object whose `_translationMeta` is surfaced. The badge auto-hides when `object` is null, when `object._translationMeta` is missing, or when `_translationMeta.translatedFrom` is null/empty.                                                                     |
| `localeNameFormatter` | `union` |          | `null`  | Optional BCP-47 → display name function. Receives the BCP-47 string from `_translationMeta.translatedFrom` and returns a user-facing label (e.g. `'nl' → 'Nederlands'`). When omitted, falls back to `Intl.DisplayNames` when available, then to the raw BCP-47 string. |
